risk: A patient with a red-flag symptom is not told to call 999 because the app shows the outcome late or not at all
owner: Northbridge app product owner + Medivane clinical lead
plan: The emergency outcome comes back in the same API response as the answer that triggered it, and the app must show it before anything else; tested in every UAT round; the webhook is only a second channel for the hospital
early_warning_sign: Any UAT script where the emergency screen is not the first thing shown

risk: The clinical safety case is not signed off in time
plan: Start the hazard log in week 2; book two hazard workshops early; Medivane sends its manufacturer safety case in week 1
early_warning_sign: Hazard workshop not booked by week 4

risk: The DPIA raises questions that change the data flow late
plan: Share the data flow diagram in week 2; keep the patient reference pseudonymous; agree retention before build starts
early_warning_sign: IG asks for a change after week 8

risk: The app agency has less capacity than planned
plan: Confirm named developers and dates before kickoff; Medivane gives sample code and two review sessions a week
early_warning_sign: Backend endpoints not in sandbox by week 8

risk: Webhook alerts fail without anyone noticing (expired certificate or firewall change)
plan: Monitoring on failed deliveries; Medivane retries for one hour then emails both on-call contacts; certificate expiry on the change calendar
early_warning_sign: Delivery failures above 1% in a day

risk: Nurses do not trust the outcome and redo the assessment by hand, which makes calls longer
plan: Involve 3 nurses in UAT; show the reasoning summary; nurses can change the urgency with a reason; review changes every 2 weeks
early_warning_sign: Nurse urgency changes above 12% in a week

risk: Patients drop out of the assessment in the app
plan: Track drop-off per question from week 1; fix the worst question first; plain-language review of question text

risk: Scope creep: requests for EPR write-back or extra languages during phase 1
plan: Change requests go to a list for phase 2 with an estimate; steering decides
early_warning_sign: New requirement raised in a status meeting without a change request

risk: The product is used for people it was not designed for (under 16, pregnancy)
plan: Age check before the first question; clear exclusion screen with where to go instead; covered in the safety case
early_warning_sign: Number of people stopped at the age check rises week on week

plan: Status page + alerts to Northbridge; app shows a fallback message with the advice-line number and 999; advice line keeps its paper protocol for outages
